_comment: Known drift per frame/case: the harness fails when a case gets worse than this (plus slack: 2.0% pixels, 1.0 px bounds, 0.5 px font). Regenerate with -PvitroParityUpdateBaseline=true; keep or write each "reason". An update records regressions too: read the diff before committing it, and keep the entries of cases with an open regression. #794 empties this file.

mirror/clock-date.reason: Vitro doesn't draw date_format's date line (HA: "Monday November 23" under the time, which HA moves up to make room; at this size HA clips the date's first letter itself). #791

mirror/markdown-cardmod.reason: harness limit: Robolectric's Skia draws Inter's default instance and ignores its wght/opsz axes, so the 56 px weight-300 h1 renders regular and its line box differs (Humidity 2 px higher, card ~2.5 px off). On the panels Inter's axes apply: the Vitro Glass clock's light digits draw like HA's on the tablet and the S1 (2026-11-24)

mirror/markdown-cardmod-has.reason: of the card_mod sheet Vitro applies only :host ha-card (the border); not :host { --card-text-align } (text stays left), ha-card:has(...) (no tint), or :has() in the ha-markdown$ sheet (heading not green, the bold paragraph 14 px, not 18). #791

mirror/markdown-img-natural.reason: Vitro drops a Markdown with no width or height; HA shows it at its natural size (192 px here), so Vitro's card is 212 px shorter. #791

mirror/mushroom-chips.reason: values now match HA (display precision from the registry); what's left is text rendering and chip edges about 1 px apart, just over 2% at the 1.5x panels' density

mirror/thermostat.reason: the dial's texts (Off, 17.5 °C) are drawn on its canvas, so the harness can't find them as text runs; pixels 0.2%
